text:
Kai (Product): quick follow-up from today's all-hands Q&A: lots of external teams asked for a single, short timeline + clear 'ship gates' for API v2, Console GA, and Optimize's cost-recommendation feature. can leadership commit to targets we can share with partners?

Sophie (CEO): yes we can share targets but label them as "targets". let's publish a one-page timeline + explicit gates this week. we'll promise a canary status update ~10 days after canary starts. :white_check_mark:

Leon (Eng): engineering context on API v2: API surface is stable. remaining risks: one kernel perf patch, quantization validation, and a security follow-up. rollout plan: 7d canary -> 7d ramp -> opt-in -> GA. if canary + perf pass, GA about 34 weeks after canary start.

Mei (Platform): Console GA blockers are tenant migration tooling and RBAC parity. plan: internal dry-run in August, invited beta in September, GA in October. ops needs a rollback-tested migration runbook and 48h post-migration monitoring.

Ravi (DevRel): partners want a clear matrix (beta features vs GA features), SDK changelog, and migration scripts. Product should publish a short matrix + sample scripts.

Kai (Product): draft targets (provisional):
```
- API v2: canary start ~ 2026-08-11, GA target ~ 2026-09-28
- Console: invited beta ~ 2026-09-18, GA target ~ 2026-10-12
- Optimize (cost recommendations): opt-in preview ~ 2026-09-04, public beta ~ 2026-09-26
```

Leon (Eng): proposed acceptance gates for API v2: 
- security audit completed and no P1s
- P99 latency <= 1.25x baseline across canary
- token cost regression <= 1.15x baseline
- no memory growth after 72h soak
I'll post the perf checklist to the eng board.

Mei (Platform): Console gates:
- migration dry-run success on 3 tenants
- rollback script validated
- runbook verified < 30m/tenant
- 48h post-migration monitoring green
Ops will sign off after the 48h window.

Ravi (DevRel): partner comms checklist: feature-flag names, SDK deprecations, SDK snippets for migration, and a short migration troubleshooting doc. I'll draft the partner FAQ and sample scripts.

Kai (Product): action items (owners):
1) Kai -> publish one-pager timeline + feature matrix (owner)
2) Leon -> finalize perf checklist and PR template updates (owner)
3) Mei -> schedule dry-runs, publish migration runbook (owner)
4) Ravi -> partner FAQ + sample scripts (owner)
I'll post links in this thread by Thursday EOD.

infra-bot: scheduled: canary-fleet-reserve queued for 2026-08-03 08:30 UTC.

Leon (Eng): small ask: can infra pin a stable driver and CUDA stack for canary to avoid noisy perf variance?

Mei (Platform): will pin driver v525.85 and a fixed CUDA runtime for the canary window. noted.

Sophie (CEO): decision summary: publish target windows with "target / provisional" label, and provide a canary update 10 days after canary start. keep this thread as the single partner-facing source and keep replies short. thanks all. :thumbsup:
